name: io.github.flow-steward/everos
title: EverOS
description: Store and recall durable facts, browse memories and record task trajectories through your deployment of the official EverOS MCP server.

instance_host.description: HTTPS host name of your deployed MCP server, without a scheme or path. Configure TLS and publish the documented /mcp endpoint on this host.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Caller EverOS API key forwarded to the configured backend. Enter the complete header value: Bearer <api-key>.

headers.name: X-EverOS-User-Id
headers.description: Optional memory owner within this API key space; defaults to default-user. This identifier is not an authorization boundary.
